acv.quote: The account was worth about three hundred and twenty K a year.

header.reason: The US stayed, but the international half went to Adyen, whose test gave Stefan results by country. We answered with averages. Our analysis found fixable issues but arrived after the test ended.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with each customer's declines by country, not company-wide results.
findings.why: Stefan, the new head of payments, started by pulling declines by country and saw weak international markets.
findings.quote: the first thing he did was pull declines by country

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Show the customer's own approval gap in a number the CFO accepts.
findings.why: Stefan recommended the switch and the CFO approved it. Stefan said an average would not convince his CFO.
findings.quote: I can't take an average to my CFO.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Answer 'local acquiring' directly with our approvals by country.
findings.why: After Adyen tested his international traffic, Stefan asked our rates by country, card type and issuer. Adyen's results were never shared.
findings.quote: What's our approval rate in this country, on this card type, by issuer.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Replace the average uplift claim with the customer's own approval numbers.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: Stefan brushed off the Authorization Boost average, and the uplift number got only silence.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Promise a market-by-market view of their own approvals, with reasons.
findings.why: Stefan called our analysis the most useful thing we sent, but it came three weeks late.
findings.quote: A market-by-market view of their own approval rates, with reasons.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'approvals' and 'money left on the table', not 'authorization' or 'uplift'.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: Stefan's headline for the problem was money left on the table, and he says approvals, not authorization.
